title: Sounds around you
intro: A short pause for the ears. Skip any step that does not suit you.

steps.text: Let your hands rest, and simply listen. Notice the first sound that reaches you.
Find the closest sound. It might be a keyboard, a fan or your own movement.
Now find the farthest sound you can. Traffic, birds, a door or a distant voice all count.
Listen for any sound that comes and goes. Notice how it fades in and out.
Listen for the quiet between sounds, then let your attention come back to the room.

closing: That was a short spell of listening. Carry on when you are ready.
